New to cryptography? Essential notation

λ (lambda) measures the security level; p is a prime number; ℤₚ means arithmetic with remainders modulo p. N is a public set-size bound in PSI, but the number of candidates in voting. ←$ means sample uniformly at random.

Negligible probability means smaller than 1/λc for every fixed positive exponent c, once λ is sufficiently large. Computationally indistinguishable means no efficient test can reliably tell two distributions apart, beyond negligible advantage. A simulator is an algorithm that constructs the allowed view without access to the hidden secrets.
